budget_priority: Independent of value sensitivity and voluntary activity; existing cash/margin/settlement rules retain precedence. Budget restoration has no margin rationing exemption. No direct target or account edits.
budget_rule: For value traders after optional direction handling, intersect reachable orders [-M,M] with budget-feasible orders [-L-h,L-h]. Project qD only when nonempty; otherwise -sign(h)*M.
